name: Ray Marcher with Macrocell Empty Space Skipping
definition: A ray marching technique that uses precomputed macrocell densities to skip empty space, improving performance when many coarse elements have zero density.
summary: Ray Marcher with Macrocell Empty Space Skipping accelerates volume rendering by skipping empty regions using a fixed uniform grid of precomputed boolean occupancy flags, distinguishing it from tree-based or simple occupancy grid methods.
